test_cache_ping: test the cache ping endpoint to verify the cache is healthy and responsive
delete_cache_keys: delete specified keys from the Redis cache using a POST request with a keys list
get_redis_info: get Redis client count, client list, and server info from the cache instance
flush_cache_all: flush all items from the Redis cache to clear the entire cache store
extract_cache_params: extract and mask cache configuration parameters for health check display
